{{Top|leg}}
A '''harvester crawler''' was a large piece of [[Farm/Legends|farm]] equipment used by [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] to tend their fields. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers who cultivated lands on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]] used harvester crawlers<ref name="RoKD">{{WEGCite|story=Ruins of Kabus-Dabeh|book=Tales of the Jedi Companion}}</ref> in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref>
